1.text: Dat which was from tha beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen wit our eyes, which we have looked upon, N our hands have handled, of tha Word of life;
(4 tha life was manifested, N we have seen it, N bear witness, N show 2 u dat eternal life, which was wit tha Father, N was manifested 2 us;)
Dat which we have seen N heard declare we 2 u, dat y’all also may have fellowship wit us: N truly our fellowship is wit tha Father, N wit his Son Jesus Christ.
N dese things write we 2 u, dat ur joy may be full.
Dis then is tha message which we have heard of him, N declare 2 u, dat God is light, N in him is no darkness at all.
If we say dat we have fellowship wit him, N walk in darkness, we lie, N do not tha truth:
But if we walk in tha light, as he is in tha light, we have fellowship one wit another, N tha blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
If we say dat we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, N tha truth is not in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful N just 2 forgive us our sins, N 2 cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
If we say dat we have not sinned, we make him a liar, N his word is not in us.

2.text: My little children, dese things write I 2 u, dat y’all sin not. N if any man sin, we have an advocate wit tha Father, Jesus Christ tha righteous:
N he is tha propitiation 4 our sins: N not 4 ours only, but also 4 tha sins of tha whole world.
N by dis we do know dat we know him, if we keep his commandments.
He dat says, I know him, N keeps not his commandments, is a liar, N tha truth is not in him.
But whoever keeps his word, in him for real is tha love of God perfected: by dis know we dat we r in him.
He dat says he abides in him ought himself also so 2 walk, even as he walked.
Brothers, I write no new commandment 2 u, but an old commandment which y’all had from tha beginning. tha old commandment is tha word which y’all have heard from tha beginning.
Again, a new commandment I write 2 u, which thing is true in him N in u: because tha darkness is past, N tha true light now shines.
He dat says he is in tha light, N hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.
He dat loves his brother abides in tha light, N there is none occasion of stumblin in him.
But he dat hates his brother is in darkness, N walks in darkness, N knows not where he goes, because dat darkness has blinded his eyes.
I write 2 u, little children, because ur sins r forgiven u 4 his name’s sake.

I write 2 u, fathers, because y’all have known him dat is from tha beginning. I write 2 u, young men, because y’all have overcome tha wicked one. I write 2 u, little children, because y’all have known tha Father.

I have written 2 u, fathers, because y’all have known him dat is from tha beginning. I have written 2 u, young men, because y’all r strong, N tha word of God abides in u, N y’all have overcome tha wicked one.
Love not tha world, neither tha things dat r in tha world. If any man love tha world, tha love of tha Father is not in him.
4 all dat is in tha world, tha lust of tha flesh, N tha lust of tha eyes, N tha pride of life, is not of tha Father, but is of tha world.
N tha world passes away, N tha lust of it: but he dat does tha will of God abides 4 ever.
Little children, it is tha last time: N as y’all have heard dat antichrist shall come, even now r there many antichrists; whereby we know dat it is tha last time.
Dey went out from us, but dey were not of us; 4 if dey had been of us, dey would no doubt have continued wit us: but dey went out, dat dey might be made manifest dat dey were not all of us.
But y’all have an unction from tha Holy One, N y’all know all things.
I have not written 2 u because y’all know not tha truth, but because y’all know it, N dat no lie is of tha truth.
Who is a liar but he dat denieth dat Jesus is tha Christ? He is antichrist, dat denieth tha Father N tha Son.
Whoever denieth tha Son, tha same has not tha Father: (but) he dat acknowledgeth tha Son has tha Father also.
Let dat therefore abide in u, which y’all have heard from tha beginning. If dat which y’all have heard from tha beginning shall remain in u, y’all also shall continue in tha Son, N in tha Father.
N dis is tha promise dat he has promised us, even eternal life.
Dese things have I written 2 u concerning ’em dat seduce u.

But tha anointing which y’all have received of him abides in u, N y’all need not dat any man teach u: but as tha same anointing teaches u of all things, N is truth, N is no lie, N even as it has taught u, y’all shall abide in him.
N now, little children, abide in him; dat, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, N not be ashamed before him at his comin.
If y’all know dat he is righteous, y’all know dat every one dat does righteousness is born of him.

3.text: Look, what manner of love tha Father has bestowed upon us, dat we should be called tha sons of God: therefore tha world knows us not, because it knew him not.
Beloved, now r we tha sons of God, N it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know dat, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; 4 we shall see him as he is.
N every man dat has dis hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
Whoever commits sin transgresseth also tha law: 4 sin is tha transgression of tha law.
N y’all know dat he was manifested 2 take away our sins; N in him is no sin.
Whoever abides in him sins not: whoever sins has not seen him, neither known him.
Little children, let no man deceive u: he dat does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
He dat commits sin is of tha devil; 4 tha devil sins from tha beginning. 4 dis purpose tha Son of God was manifested, dat he might destroy tha works of tha devil.
Whoever is born of God does not commit sin; 4 his seed remains in him: N he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
In dis tha children of God r manifest, N tha children of tha devil: whoever does not righteousness is not of God, neither he dat loves not his brother.
4 dis is tha message dat y’all heard from tha beginning, dat we should love one another.
Not as Cain, who was of dat wicked one, N killed his brother. N so killed he him? Because his own works were evil, N his brother’s righteous.
Marvel not, my brothers, if tha world hate u.
We know dat we have passed from death 2 life, because we love tha brothers. He dat loves not his brother abides in death.
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer: N y’all know dat no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
By dis perceive we tha love of God, because he laid down his life 4 us: N we ought 2 lay down our lives 4 tha brothers.
But whoever has dis world’s good, N sees his brother have need, N shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how lives tha love of God in him?
My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed N in truth.
N by dis we know dat we r of tha truth, N shall assure our hearts before him.
4 if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, N knows all things.
Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
N whatever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, N do dose things dat r pleasing in his sight.
N dis is his commandment, dat we should believe on tha name of his Son Jesus Christ, N love one another, as he gave us commandment.
N he dat keeps his commandments lives in him, N he in him. N by dis we know dat he abides in us, by tha Spirit which he has given us.

4.text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try tha spirits whether dey r of God: because many false prophets r gone out in2 tha world.
By dis know y’all tha Spirit of God: Every spirit dat confesseth dat Jesus Christ is come in tha flesh is of God:

N every spirit dat confesseth not dat Jesus Christ is come in tha flesh is not of God: N dis is dat spirit of antichrist, whereof y’all have heard dat it should come; N even now already is it in tha world.
y’all r of God, little children, N have overcome ’em: because greater is he dat is in u, than he dat is in tha world.
Dey r of tha world: therefore speak dey of tha world, N tha world hears ’em.
We r of God: he dat knows God hears us; he dat is not of God hears not us. by dis know we tha spirit of truth, N tha spirit of error.
Beloved, let us love one another: 4 love is of God; N every one dat loves is born of God, N knows God.
He dat loves not knows not God; 4 God is love.
In dis was manifested tha love of God toward us, because dat God sent his only begotten Son in2 tha world, dat we might live through him.
In dis is love, not dat we loved God, but dat he loved us, N sent his Son 2 be tha propitiation 4 our sins.
Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also 2 love one another.
No man has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God lives in us, N his love is perfected in us.
By dis know we dat we live in him, N he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
N we have seen N do testify dat tha Father sent tha Son 2 be tha Saviour of tha world.
Whoever shall confess dat Jesus is tha Son of God, God lives in him, N he in God.
N we have known N believed tha love dat God has 2 us. God is love; N he dat lives in love lives in God, N God in him.
In dis is our love made perfect, dat we may have boldness in tha day of judgment: because as he is, so r we in dis world.
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear: because fear has torment. He dat fears is not made perfect in love.
We love him, because he first loved us.
If a man say, I love God, N hates his brother, he is a liar: 4 he dat loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
N dis commandment have we from him, dat he who loves God love his brother also.

5.text: Whoever believes dat Jesus is tha Christ is born of God: N every one dat loves him dat fathered loves him also dat is begotten of him.
By dis we know dat we love tha children of God, when we love God, N keep his commandments.
4 dis is tha love of God, dat we keep his commandments: N his commandments r not grievous.
4 whatever is born of God overcomes tha world: N dis is tha victory dat overcomes tha world, even our faith.
Who is he dat overcomes tha world, but he dat believes dat Jesus is tha Son of God?
Dis is he dat came by water N blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water N blood. N it is tha Spirit dat bears witness, because tha Spirit is truth.
4 there r three dat bear record in heaven, tha Father, tha Word, N tha Holy Ghost: N dese three r one.
N there r three dat bear witness in earth, tha Spirit, N tha water, N tha blood: N dese three agree in one.
If we receive tha witness of men, tha witness of God is greater: 4 dis is tha witness of God which he has testified of his Son.
He dat believes on tha Son of God has tha witness in himself: he dat believes not God has made him a liar; because he believes not tha record dat God gave of his Son.
N dis is tha record, dat God has given 2 us eternal life, N dis life is in his Son.
He dat has tha Son has life; N he dat has not tha Son of God has not life.
Dese things have I written 2 u dat believe on tha name of tha Son of God; dat y’all may know dat y’all have eternal life, N dat y’all may believe on tha name of tha Son of God.
N dis is tha confidence dat we have in him, dat, if we ask any thing according 2 his will, he hears us:
N if we know dat he hear us, whatever we ask, we know dat we have tha petitions dat we desired of him.
If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not 2 death, he shall ask, N he shall give him life 4 ’em dat sin not 2 death. There is a sin 2 death: I do not say dat he shall pray 4 it.
All unrighteousness is sin: N there is a sin not 2 death.
We know dat whoever is born of God sins not; but he dat is begotten of God keeps himself, N dat wicked one touches him not.
N we know dat we r of God, N tha whole world lies in wickedness.
N we know dat tha Son of God is come, N has given us an understanding, dat we may know him dat is true, N we r in him dat is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. dis is tha true God, N eternal life.
Little children, keep y’all from idols. Amen.
